name: Pluggy
long_description:
Pluggy is a B2B Fintech that allows any developer to connect to the data from their users' bank and broker accounts, essentially Plaid for Brazil. 

We are 100% focused in Brazil. One of the largest markets in the world. Its complexity, risks and challenges require its own solution.

Local focus and our deep experience in banking tech engineering allowed Pluggy to create a product that is considered by our customers as the only one to provide reliable data at the right time to market.

We currently cover 90% of the bank accounts in Brazil a market of more than 7 billion USD. 

We are Pluggy!
one_liner: Plaid for Brazil: we allow developers to access users' financial data

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Responsible for operations at Pluggy, making my best to use the knowledge that I've acquired working 10 years in Business Consulting and more 3 years in Digital Transformation Consulting to build and deliver the best product for the Brazilian Market

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Used to work in banking and M&A consultancy, but left the corporate world to create new ways of making the world a better place!

I am working with my great co-founders at Pluggy to make Open Banking in Brazil as disruptive as Brazilians need.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Federico Mirás (or "Fefo") is an Argentinian tech entrepreneur, investor and programmer. He is the Co-Founder, Head of Product, and CEO of Pluggy. Fefo wrote his first lines of code at the age of 12 and created his first software company at the age of 19. Strong leadership and company culture skills, he loves crypto & video games.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Argentinian Tech-Founder and Developer, leading the product and development of Pluggy´s solution, building developer-driven innovation with the latest technologies. Analytical, organized & practical, focus on shipping solutions as faster as possible.
